name: walletwall-openai
description: Inspect supplied stablecoin evidence and evaluate WalletWall vault technical readiness.

interface.longDescription: Inspect supplied stablecoin evidence for asset identity, provenance, conflicts, and freshness. WalletWall applies published technical-readiness criteria to structured evidence you provide and uses bundled point-in-time references for asset lookup. Its tools operate read-only. Results describe evidence under those criteria and carry no assurance about wallet security, investment merit, or quantum resistance.
defaultPrompt: Resolve this stablecoin using its chain ID and contract address.
Inspect this supplied evidence bundle for conflicts, freshness, and source provenance.
Assess technical readiness from this supplied bundle and explain the criteria and evidence gaps.

review.commerce_description: This plugin has no payments, subscriptions, advertising, checkout, or purchase flows.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote release of WalletWall Vault Readiness for ChatGPT and Codex. Six read-only tools inspect supplied stablecoin evidence, trace provenance, check evidence consistency, and evaluate WalletWall technical-readiness criteria using versioned point-in-time references.
